translations.answer: The original questioner reported that the combination can run after bypassing the Torch version problem; however, another user encountered a 'KeyError: obs_groups' on Ubuntu 22.04/RTX 5070 on the same Sim/Lab major version and could not run the project. Therefore, it is not a universal solution, but a snapshot of an environment with a counterexample.
translations.applicability: Only applicable to the original questioner's incomplete public environment; same-thread counterexample exists for Ubuntu 22.04/RTX 5070.
translations.credibility.rationale: The answer has not been closed or there is a conflict in the source; the conclusion is not fully resolved.
translations.details.attempts.0: Downgrade Isaac Lab; switch Isaac Sim/Lab combination; reinstall the project with official pip installation documentation and set the project PYTHONPATH; fix rsl-rl-lib 2.2.0 or 2.3.0.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Record Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, rsl-rl-lib, Python, installation method, and project submission separately; do not only record Isaac Lab major version; retest on Isaac-Ant-v0 and project task.
translations.details.environments.0: Original post: Isaac Sim 5.0.0, Isaac Lab package shows 0.47.1, Python 3.11; comments mention Isaac Lab 2.1.0/2.2.0/2.2.1, Isaac Sim 4.5/5.0, rsl-rl-lib 2.2.0/2.3.0, Ubuntu 22.04, RTX 5070/5070 Ti.
translations.details.limits.0: No maintenance response for the issue; no locked file or minimal reproducible repository; the original post's 0.47.1 and comments mentioning 2.x naming do not explain, so cannot determine a unique recommended version.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Different participants reported incompatible success/failure combinations on different machines; the only common conclusion is that all dependency matrices must be verified together.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Tracking-Flat-G1-v0 throws KeyError: obs_groups during OnPolicyRunner initialization; should we switch to Isaac Lab/Sim or use rsl-rl library version?
translations.details.symptoms.0: rsl_rl/runners/on_policy_runner.py throws KeyError when accessing self.cfg['obs_groups']; some combinations fix the KeyError but then encounter missing 'rnd_state' in infos['observations'].
